messages:
sylvia_fin: Meridian Health reported ~48k missing token units on their Dec invoice. They attached diffs and asked for a root cause before month end.

marta_support: INV-MERIDIAN-20271201 already issued; customer opened a ticket and forwarded sample requests showing our counts are lower.

jess_ingest: quick triage: our preprocessor vendor started returning vendor_token_count=0 for annotated multipart payloads at 2027-12-01T03:05Z. Our emitter prefers that header when present, so we undercounted. Example log: 
`2027-12-01T03:05:12Z request_id=m-89 preproc_status=200 vendor_token_count=0 computed_tokens=12 emit=true`

metering-bot: Alert: upstream-preproc-token-mismatch detected for meridian between 2027-12-01T03:05Z and 2027-12-01T03:45Z. suspected_undercount=48,300 tokens.

sylvia_fin: what's the estimated dollar impact and options? backfill vs credit?

jess_ingest: recount SQL (using computed_tokens) shows missing_tokens=48,300 => ~$48.30 at our per-token rate.

nlp-preproc-vendor: we deployed a change that compressed token reporting; it accidentally zeroes token_count for certain annotated payloads. rolling back now and will post a patch. sorry.

marta_support: customer wants timeline.

jess_ingest: plan: run backfill BF-4301 to recompute tokens server-side for affected window and emit reconciled meter events (recon id MER-RECON-20271201). ETA ~90m.

sylvia_fin: approve provisional credit up to $80 if backfill cannot complete before invoice adjustment window. I'll open FIN-1182.

metering-bot: Backfill BF-4301: started at 2027-12-01T05:10Z.

jess_ingest: BF-4301 progress 60% (29k tokens emitted). No checksum mismatches.

metering-bot: BF-4301: success. reconciled_tokens=48,312 reconciliation_ref=MER-RECON-20271201.

sylvia_fin: backfill succeeded; no credit needed. attaching MER-RECON-20271201 to INV-MERIDIAN-20271201 and closing FIN-1182.

marta_support: customer updated and appreciated the quick fix.

jess_ingest: action items: 1) emitter should ignore vendor token_count if zero or implausible; 2) add unit test for vendor header regressions; 3) vendor to add pre-release notice to our integration channel.

sylvia_fin: thanks team, closing thread.
